summary: Join our Data Analytics course designed for the Utilities and Energy sector. Learn to leverage data for improved decision-making and operational efficiency.
lede: Energy data analytics uses utility, customer, asset, and energy records to support operational and investment decisions. For utility analysts, energy managers, asset specialists, and operations supervisors, this course develops practical skills in assessing data quality, forecasting demand, and analyzing outages and asset risks. Participants also practise defining performance indicators and designing dashboard concepts for operational reporting.
audienceIntro: Utility data analytics training suits professionals who work with electricity, gas, water, renewable energy, or integrated utility operations and need stronger evidence for daily decisions, performance reviews, and investment planning.
modules: Power BI Reporting and Decision Workflows
prerequisites: No programming experience is required. You should have basic familiarity with utility operations, energy consumption, assets, customers, or performance reporting. Working knowledge of spreadsheets is useful but not mandatory. Exercises use provided datasets and templates, so you do not need access to live SCADA, AMI, GIS, OMS, EAM, or CMMS systems. Participants should bring a laptop if the delivery format permits digital exercises.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
